blocks.prompt: 5 (i) Find the values of \(\sin\theta\) and \(\cos\theta\) without using table or calculator, when \(\theta\) is: \(18^{\circ}\)
blocks.explanation:
\(18^{\circ}\) table ka angle nahi, lekin is ki ek khaas baat hai: \(5 \times 18^{\circ} = 90^{\circ}\). Isi se raasta nikalta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\theta = 18^{\circ}\). Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 18^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 18^{\circ}\) ki exact values, bina table ya calculator.
Plan (kitab ka hint): \(5\theta = 90^{\circ}\) ko \(3\theta = 90^{\circ} - 2\theta\) likhna, dono taraf sin lena, aur \(\sin\theta\) ki equation hal karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\theta = 18^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin 18^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 18^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa: \(5\theta = 90^{\circ}\) ko do hisson mein torein: \(3\theta + 2\theta = 90^{\circ}\), yani \(3\theta = 90^{\circ} - 2\theta\). Dono taraf sin lene se triple angle aur double angle ke formulas aa jayenge, aur sab kuch \(\sin\theta\) mein badal jayega.

Equation banayein
\[\sin 3\theta = \sin(90^{\circ} - 2\theta)\]
\[\sin 3\theta = \cos 2\theta\]
Kyun: Barabar angles ke sin barabar hote hain. Phir \(\sin(90^{\circ} - x) = \cos x\) (complementary angles) lagaya.

Sab ko \(s = \sin\theta\) mein likhein
\[3s - 4s^3 = 1 - 2s^2\]
\[4s^3 - 2s^2 - 3s + 1 = 0\]
Kyun: \(\sin 3\theta = 3\sin\theta - 4\sin^3\theta\) (Section 10.6) aur \(\cos 2\theta = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta\) (Section 10.4). Humne \(\cos 2\theta\) ki woh shakal chuni jis mein sirf sin hai, taake ek hi variable rahe. Phir sab terms ek taraf le gaye.

Factor karein
\[(s - 1)(4s^2 + 2s - 1) = 0\]
Kyun: \(s = 1\) rakhne se \(4 - 2 - 3 + 1 = 0\) aata hai, is liye Factor Theorem se \(s - 1\) ek factor hai (Unit 9 yaad karein). Baqi quadratic synthetic division se milta hai. Lekin \(\sin 18^{\circ}\) 1 nahi ho sakta (\(\sin 90^{\circ} = 1\) hai), is liye \(4s^2 + 2s - 1 = 0\).

Quadratic hal karein
\[s = \dfrac{-2 \pm \sqrt{4 + 16}}{8}\]
\[= \dfrac{-1 \pm \sqrt{5}}{4}\]
\[\sin 18^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{5} - 1}{4}\]
Kyun: Quadratic formula, \(a = 4\), \(b = 2\), \(c = -1\): \(b^2 - 4ac = 4 + 16 = 20\), aur \(\sqrt{20} = 2\sqrt{5}\). Upar neeche 2 se cancel kiya. Do jawab aaye; \(18^{\circ}\) quadrant I mein hai, sin positive, is liye \(\frac{-1 + \sqrt{5}}{4}\) rakha aur negative wala chhor diya.

\(\cos 18^{\circ}\) nikalein
\[\sin^2 18^{\circ} = \dfrac{6 - 2\sqrt{5}}{16}\]
\[\cos^2 18^{\circ} = \dfrac{10 + 2\sqrt{5}}{16}\]
\[\cos 18^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{10 + 2\sqrt{5}}}{4}\]
Kyun: \((\sqrt{5} - 1)^2 = 5 - 2\sqrt{5} + 1 = 6 - 2\sqrt{5}\). Phir \(\cos^2 = 1 - \sin^2 = \frac{16 - 6 + 2\sqrt{5}}{16}\). Quadrant I mein cos positive, is liye positive root; \(\sqrt{16} = 4\) bahar aa gaya.

Tasdeeq (andaze se)
\[\dfrac{\sqrt{5} - 1}{4} \approx \dfrac{1.236}{4} = 0.309\]
Kyun: \(18^{\circ}\) \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(30^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan hai, is liye \(\sin 18^{\circ}\) 0 aur 0.5 ke darmiyan hona chahiye; 0.309 bilkul munasib hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) Find the values of \(\sin\theta\) and \(\cos\theta\) without using table or calculator, when \(\theta\) is: \(36^{\circ}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa \(5 \times 36^{\circ} = 180^{\circ}\); kitab ke hint ka doosra hissa yahi hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\theta = 36^{\circ}\). Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 36^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 36^{\circ}\).
Plan: \(3\theta = 180^{\circ} - 2\theta\) se \(\sin 3\theta = \sin 2\theta\), phir \(\cos\theta\) ki quadratic equation.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\theta = 36^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin 36^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 36^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa: \(5\theta = 180^{\circ}\) ko \(3\theta = 180^{\circ} - 2\theta\) likhenge. \(\sin(180^{\circ} - x) = \sin x\) hai, is liye \(\sin 3\theta = \sin 2\theta\). Is dafa \(\cos\theta\) ki equation banegi.

\(s = \sin\theta\), \(c = \cos\theta\) mein likhein
\[3s - 4s^3 = 2sc\]
\[3 - 4s^2 = 2c\]
Kyun: Left side triple angle formula, right side \(\sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta\). Dono taraf \(s\) hai, aur \(\sin 36^{\circ}\) zero nahi, is liye \(s\) se divide kar diya.
Dhyan dein: kisi cheez se divide karne se pehle yaqeen kar lein ke woh zero nahi; warna jawab kho sakta hai.

Sirf \(c\) mein badlein
\[3 - 4(1 - c^2) = 2c\]
\[4c^2 - 2c - 1 = 0\]
Kyun: \(s^2 = 1 - c^2\) rakha. \(3 - 4 + 4c^2 = 2c\), sab ek taraf le gaye to quadratic bani.

Quadratic hal karein
\[c = \dfrac{2 \pm \sqrt{4 + 16}}{8} = \dfrac{1 \pm \sqrt{5}}{4}\]
\[\cos 36^{\circ} = \dfrac{1 + \sqrt{5}}{4}\]
Kyun: \(a = 4\), \(b = -2\), \(c = -1\) ke saath quadratic formula. \(\frac{1 - \sqrt{5}}{4}\) negative hai, lekin \(36^{\circ}\) quadrant I mein hai jahan cos positive, is liye woh chhor diya. (Woh doosra jawab asal mein \(\cos 108^{\circ}\) hai, jo Hence wale hisse mein kaam aayega.)

\(\sin 36^{\circ}\) nikalein
\[\cos^2 36^{\circ} = \dfrac{6 + 2\sqrt{5}}{16}\]
\[\sin^2 36^{\circ} = \dfrac{10 - 2\sqrt{5}}{16}\]
\[\sin 36^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{10 - 2\sqrt{5}}}{4}\]
Kyun: \((1 + \sqrt{5})^2 = 1 + 2\sqrt{5} + 5 = 6 + 2\sqrt{5}\). \(\sin^2 = 1 - \cos^2 = \frac{16 - 6 - 2\sqrt{5}}{16}\). Positive root, kyunke quadrant I.

Tasdeeq: part (i) se
\[\cos 36^{\circ} = 1 - 2\sin^2 18^{\circ}\]
\[= 1 - \dfrac{6 - 2\sqrt{5}}{8} = \dfrac{2 + 2\sqrt{5}}{8}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 + \sqrt{5}}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(36^{\circ} = 2 \times 18^{\circ}\), is liye double angle formula se bhi \(\cos 36^{\circ}\) nikal sakte hain. Bilkul wohi jawab aaya; dono parts ek doosre ki tasdeeq karte hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iii) Find the values of \(\sin\theta\) and \(\cos\theta\) without using table or calculator, when \(\theta\) is: \(54^{\circ}\)
blocks.explanation:
\(54^{\circ}\) aur \(36^{\circ}\) ka jama \(90^{\circ}\) hai, yani yeh complementary angles hain. Naya hisaab lagane ki zaroorat nahi.
Diya kya hai? \(\theta = 54^{\circ}\). Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 54^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 54^{\circ}\).
Plan: \(54^{\circ} = 90^{\circ} - 36^{\circ}\) likh kar part (ii) ke jawab istemal karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\theta = 54^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin 54^{\circ}\), \(\cos 54^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa: Complementary angles ka rule: \(\sin(90^{\circ} - x) = \cos x\) aur \(\cos(90^{\circ} - x) = \sin x\). Ek angle ka sin doosre ka cos hota hai.

\(54^{\circ} = 90^{\circ} - 36^{\circ}\) istemal karein
\[\sin 54^{\circ} = \cos 36^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{5} + 1}{4}\]
\[\cos 54^{\circ} = \sin 36^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{10 - 2\sqrt{5}}}{4}\]
Kyun: \(90^{\circ}\) odd multiple hai, is liye sin aur cos aapas mein jagah badal lete hain; quadrant I mein dono positive. Values part (ii) se seedhi utha li.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin 54^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 36^{\circ}\) ek hi number hain; exam mein yeh rishta dikha dena kaafi hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin^2 54^{\circ} + \cos^2 54^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{6 + 2\sqrt{5} + 10 - 2\sqrt{5}}{16} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono squares jama karne se \(\sqrt{5}\) wale terms cancel ho gaye aur \(\frac{16}{16} = 1\) bacha, jaisa har angle ke liye hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iv) Find the values of \(\sin\theta\) and \(\cos\theta\) without using table or calculator, when \(\theta\) is: \(72^{\circ}\)
blocks.explanation:
\(72^{\circ} + 18^{\circ} = 90^{\circ}\), is liye yeh bhi complementary jora hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\theta = 72^{\circ}\). Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 72^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 72^{\circ}\).
Plan: \(72^{\circ} = 90^{\circ} - 18^{\circ}\) aur part (i) ke jawab.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\theta = 72^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin 72^{\circ}\), \(\cos 72^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa: Complementary angles ka rule, bilkul part (iii) ki tarah, lekin is dafa \(18^{\circ}\) ke saath.

\(72^{\circ} = 90^{\circ} - 18^{\circ}\) istemal karein
\[\sin 72^{\circ} = \cos 18^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{10 + 2\sqrt{5}}}{4}\]
\[\cos 72^{\circ} = \sin 18^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{5} - 1}{4}\]
Kyun: \(90^{\circ} - x\) mein sin aur cos jagah badalte hain, aur quadrant I mein dono positive rehte hain. Values part (i) se.

Tasdeeq: double angle se
\[\cos 72^{\circ} = 2\cos^2 36^{\circ} - 1\]
\[= \dfrac{6 + 2\sqrt{5}}{8} - 1 = \dfrac{\sqrt{5} - 1}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(72^{\circ} = 2 \times 36^{\circ}\), is liye \(\cos 2x = 2\cos^2 x - 1\) se bhi nikal sakte hain. \(\frac{6 + 2\sqrt{5} - 8}{8} = \frac{2\sqrt{5} - 2}{8} = \frac{\sqrt{5} - 1}{4}\). Wohi jawab; is ka matlab hai saare parts ek doosre se mel khate hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (v) [printed without a label] Hence prove that: \(\cos 36^{\circ}\cos 72^{\circ}\cos 108^{\circ}\cos 144^{\circ} = \frac{1}{16}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh hissa kitab mein bina number ke "Hence" se shuru hota hai; hum ne usay (v) ka label diya hai. "Hence" ka matlab: abhi jo values nikali hain unhi se prove karo.
Diya kya hai? Chaar cosines ka product. Prove kya karna hai? Ke yeh \(\frac{1}{16}\) hai.
Plan: \(108^{\circ}\) aur \(144^{\circ}\) ko allied angles se \(72^{\circ}\) aur \(36^{\circ}\) mein badalna, phir values rakh kar multiply.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \cos 36^{\circ}\cos 72^{\circ}\cos 108^{\circ}\cos 144^{\circ}\).
Humein prove karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{1}{16}\).
Tareeqa: \(108^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} - 72^{\circ}\) aur \(144^{\circ} = 180^{\circ} - 36^{\circ}\). Is tarah sirf do angles bachenge jin ki values parts (ii) aur (iv) mein mil chuki hain.

Bare angles chhote karein
\[\cos 108^{\circ} = -\cos 72^{\circ}\]
\[\cos 144^{\circ} = -\cos 36^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(180^{\circ}\) even multiple, cos cos hi raha. \(108^{\circ}\) aur \(144^{\circ}\) dono quadrant II mein hain jahan cos negative hai, is liye dono ke saath minus.

Product ikattha karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \cos 36^{\circ}\cos 72^{\circ}\]
\[\quad \times (-\cos 72^{\circ})(-\cos 36^{\circ})\]
\[= (\cos 36^{\circ}\cos 72^{\circ})^2\]
Kyun: Do minus signs milkar plus. Har cos do dafa aaya, is liye poora product \(\cos 36^{\circ}\cos 72^{\circ}\) ka square ban gaya. Is se hisaab aadha ho jata hai.

Values rakhein
\[\cos 36^{\circ}\cos 72^{\circ} = \dfrac{(\sqrt{5} + 1)(\sqrt{5} - 1)}{16}\]
\[= \dfrac{5 - 1}{16} = \dfrac{1}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 36^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{5} + 1}{4}\) aur \(\cos 72^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{5} - 1}{4}\). Upar \((a + b)(a - b) = a^2 - b^2\) se \(5 - 1 = 4\), neeche \(4 \times 4 = 16\). Square roots khud hi khatam ho gaye.

Square karein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \left(\dfrac{1}{4}\right)^2 = \dfrac{1}{16} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Pichhle qadam ka \(\frac{1}{4}\) square kiya to \(\frac{1}{16}\). Right side mil gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 108^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 144^{\circ}\) ke minus signs bhool jayein to bhi jawab yahan sahi aa jata hai (kyunke do hain), lekin method ghalat hoga; signs hamesha likhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein yeh sawal "5." ki bajaye "15." ke number par hai, aur jawab printed parts ke hisaab se nahi balke ratios ke hisaab se lage hain: us ka (i) \(\sin 18^{\circ} = \cos 72^{\circ}\), (ii) \(\sin 54^{\circ} = \cos 36^{\circ}\), (iii) \(\cos 18^{\circ} = \sin 72^{\circ}\), (iv) \(\cos 54^{\circ} = \sin 36^{\circ}\). Values sahi hain, magar labels (ii)-(iv) chhape hue parts ((ii) \(36^{\circ}\), (iii) \(54^{\circ}\), (iv) \(72^{\circ}\)) se nahi milte. Upar diye gaye jawab part ba part istemal karein.
